modules.module_title: Manage manpower and material in the mines

pcs.pc_description: prepare shift rosters and allocate requisite manpower based on skills to achieve production targets
monitor overtime list for compliance with overtime distribution
maintain time sheets for mine employees along with absence reports and submit weekly to payroll or concerned authorities as per the organisational procedures
maintain the availability of material, tools and equipment in the mines as per the SOP/Work Plans

organise training sessions for the employees to improve their skills and knowledge on new techniques and methods
resolve grievances within the team or escalate them to the concerned authorities if they are beyond the scope

modules.module_title: Manage and promote safe working on site

pcs.pc_description: implement company requirements and legal regulations, paying specific attention to HSE legislation and quality
give directions as may be necessary to ensure compliance with safety of the district and the safety and proper discipline of the persons employed therein
ensure proper use and maintenance of personal protective equipment
carry out and record site inspections
identify problems (e.g. obstructions, geological movements, mechanical or service failure) and report to appropriate person/s for advice or repair/remedial action
prepare reports on accident/incident that happen during the shift
conduct daily pre-shift meetings to ensure employees are informed of safety and production issues
check all pre-shift reports and note any dangerous or hazardous conditions included in the pre-shift report
give prompt attention to the removal of any danger observed or reported to him, and shall see that dangerous places are adequately fenced off
trace locations and identify emergency signals sent through the use of modern communication systems like Fleet Management System (FMS), Leaky feeder, etc.
conduct incident investigations, hazard analysis, and identify root-causes
implement Safety Management Plan (SMP)
oversee end to end mining operations i.e. stripping, drilling, blasting, loading etc.
supervise all operations connected with the transport of explosives and blasting in the mine
ensure that adequate precautions are taken before blasting operations are conducted
mark headings for drilling to maintain alignment and heading dimension
examine roof conditions and work with the mine crew to correct defects in the mine roof
monitor that methane tests should be conducted throughout the shift
ensure that every place where methane is likely to accumulate is properly ventilated (deflector curtains, etc.)
ensure that every air-crossing, stopping, door, brattice and other ventilation device is well constructed and maintained in good order

ensure that the ventilation is effective in the district; and when brattices or air pipes or ducts are required to be used for the ventilation of the working places, they are kept sufficiently advance
ensure that all tracks and tramlines are properly laid, graded, ballasted or otherwise packed
ensure that the manholes on the haulage roadways are kept safe, clear of any obstruction, and properly whitewashed
ensure that the stop-blocks, runway switches and other safety devices are fixed and used as required under the regulations
stop the use of any ropes, chains, signals, brakes, jig wheels and post or other apparatus in use in the district, if find in an unsafe condition
ensure that sides of benches are kept dressed and there stability is not endangered
ensure that adequate lighting is provided at area under his control and no over-crowding of men and machinery at the working faces
visit each working place in the district as often as may be necessary or possible

modules.module_title: Monitor and control the employees working in the mine district

pcs.pc_description: monitor, record and control the number of persons in respective area of responsibility
ensure that the subordinate officials and competent persons in his/her district carry out their respective duties in a proper manner
ensure that except for the purpose of inspection, examination and repairs every person other than an official or a haulage attendant travels by the travelling roadway

send out of the mine any person under his/her charge infringing or attempting to infringe any provision of the Act or of the regulations or orders made thereunder, or failing to carry out any direction given with regard to safety
report in writing any such infringement or attempted infringement or failure to the manager

if the mine is working in a continuous succession of shifts, confer with the official succeeding him and give him such information as may be necessary for the safety of district and of persons employed therein, before leaving the district

prepare a general report in the specified format on the performance of all duties during the shift, including anything concerning the proper working of the mine and the safety and discipline of persons employed in his district at the end of shift
mark their observations clearly at shift-end, in registers and communicate the same during handover
